latitude.title: Latitude (for a single location)
latitude.description: Leave the Locations (multiple) field below empty to use this single-location shortcut instead. US locations only (National Weather Service coverage).

longitude.title: Longitude (for a single location)
longitude.description: Only used together with Latitude above.

label.title: Label (optional)
label.description: Optional display name for the single location above, e.g. "Austin, TX".

locations.title: Locations (multiple)
locations.description: For checking several locations in one run instead of one at a time. List of { "label": "optional name", "latitude": 30.2672, "longitude": -97.7431 }. US locations only. Ignored if Latitude above is filled in.

forecastPeriods.title: Forecast periods to include
forecastPeriods.description: How many forecast periods to return (each period is ~12 hours: day/night). Default 4 = next 2 days.
